Name: Tertius
Role: Amanuensis of the Epistle to the Romans
Summary: Tertius was the scribe who wrote down Paul's Epistle to the Romans at Paul's dictation, adding his own greeting in the Lord.
KeyStory: Tertius was the scribe who wrote down Paul's Epistle to the Romans at Paul's dictation, adding his own greeting in the Lord.
LifeLesson: Those who serve behind the scenes, pen in hand, share in the work they help deliver.
